name: Nalsor

facts.text: Nalsor's reason for carrying off the seed, and Tomos standing behind him, are Living Server writing.

story:
Afal Dyffryn, the apple valley north of Wearyall, had the oldest trees on the isle, and four keepers, Brent, Lenor, Andryw and Tomos, who were buried among them as the colleges' gardeners always were, so that they could go on keeping. The trees burned. The keepers did not rest. The dead harvesters still walk the rows picking fruit that is not there.

Nalsor is the drakoran who carried off their seed. He gathered it from the four orchards the spring after the burning, every pip and kernel the keepers had saved for the next planting, and he holds it in the valley with a legion camp round him, and he will not say what for. The garrison of Wearyall says the drakoran mean to plant Avalon's apples in their own Avalon below. Madilen Anglesey says Nalsor only wants the keepers to stay awake, because keepers who are waiting for their seed will never lie down and leave the valley empty for anyone else.

Tomos, the youngest of the keepers, stands behind Nalsor, the cider-man says, always just out of sight, and waits. He will come out when Nalsor falls, and not before.
legend: Nalsor, level 35, Drakoran Legion, in Afal Dyffryn north of Wearyall. About twenty sawbones and looters plus a pile of undead apple harvesters are in the valley: Nalsor's faction will come with him, so pull him to the edge. Plain melee. For Spirits of the Orchard kill him, then give Karayan's potion to Tomos, who shows up when Nalsor dies, and tell him to pour it over the seeds. Respawn 80 seconds.

death: The seed... goes back... to the ground...

lairEntry: Nalsor guards stolen seed. Tomos waits behind him.
